rationale.campaign_length: 25项专属，L65形成是区域目标而非已确认新长树。
rationale.colonization: 已读核心没有殖民循环，不把新增领土当殖民。
rationale.complexity: 阶层、王冠领地、天气行动与粮仓等级互锁。
rationale.dark_story: 奴隶收割和可选驱逐有明确文本；存在较宽容商贸分支。
rationale.difficulty: 需同步内政与战争，DLC差异影响某些菜单，未实机测评。
rationale.diplomacy: 贵族、神职、法师及哈里玛利商贸关系有实际作用。
rationale.early_pressure: 摄政与邻国压力、早期投资需求；非实测结论。
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: 天气宗教行动与雨祭司农业直接决定国家手感。
rationale.narrative_density: 阿尤法与摄政贵族、祭司及行政改革提供人物主线。
rationale.tall_play: 谷物、神庙、港口与改革是核心建设。
rationale.trade_economy: 粮食生产和河流运输构成经济基础。
rationale.warfare: 地区战争与粮食支撑的军力形成循环。

identity.appearance: 1444天空领域门吉王国，贵族摄政委员会执政，阿尤法为继承人；粮食、祭司与行政改革主线。
identity.formation_scope: 可选形成L65梅拉克门吉，改Tag；已读形成决议没有显式swap_non_generic_missions，不保证形成后未完成S57任务可达或存在新专属续篇。

national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text: 舍洛克门吉，山谷王国，它控制着东阳洲一些最肥沃、最多产的农田。虽然它缺乏丰富的矿产资源或可防御的阵地，但这片土地本身就很肥沃，农作物从这里的土壤中涌现出来，仿佛渴望被人类的双手采摘。山谷的肥沃潜力在很久以前就被注意到了，千百年来，它生产了大量的小麦、大麦和高粱，支撑着耶特费雷的大城市。
description.text_en: Shelokmengi, the valley kingdom, controlled some of the most fertile and productive farmlands in East Sarhal. Though it lacked great mineral wealth or defensible positions, the land was rich in its own right, and crops sprang from the soil here as if they longed to be picked by human hands. The fertile potential of the valley was noticed ages ago, and it has produced vast harvests of wheat, barley and sorghum for millennia, sustaining the great cities of Yeteferen.

description.text: 伟大的耶特河像一条蛇一样盘旋着，起伏不定，在舍洛克门吉的土地附近，它在土地上拐了一个大弯。自古以来，这条河的通航能力很强，成为耶特费雷人的天然公路。舍洛克门吉的许多村庄都位于耶特河的大弯附近，便于商船进入，他们会很高兴地购买舍洛克门吉的大量收成，并将它们卖给耶特河边的城市。
description.text_en: The great Yet river coils as a serpent, ebbing and flowing, and near the lands of Shelokmengi it makes a great bend across the land. Highly navigable, the river has acted as a natural highway for the Yeteferen peoples since time immemorial. Shelokmengi’s many villages are all located near or on the great Yet bend, allowing easy access to merchant vessels, who will happily buy the vast harvests of Shelokmengi and sell them to the cities upon the length of the Yet.

description.text:
收获需要很多工作。人们必须记录劳动者的情况，要种植的种子，出售的农作物数量，一年中的时间，等等。舍洛克门吉的每一个农民都变得善于掌握在行政管理中也很有用的技能，因此舍洛克门吉的国王发现人口中不乏有能力的行政人员。

这种伟大的行政技能在「秘书」耶马内身上得到了最好的体现。耶马内出生在一个农民家庭，最初只拥有一小块土地。他出色的行政能力和智慧使他的农场产量增加了许多倍，他开始增加当地村庄其他农场的产量。最终，在阿尤法二世每年的一次收割游行中，他被阿尤法二世注意到了，他的这种技能得到了认可，并被聘为国王的私人秘书。

在阿尤法二世统治的大部分时间里，耶马内都是他的重要顾问，负责王国的许多行政改革。他最富传奇色彩的壮举是在一个月内动员了一万人，尽管据耶马内说，这不过是类似于组织收割的另一项任务而已。
description.text_en:
The harvest requires much work. One must keep track of the laborers, the seeds to be planted, the amount of crops sold, the time of the year, and more. Every farmer of Shelokmengi became adept at skills that were also useful in administration, and so the kings of Shelokmengi found no shortage of competent administrators among the population.

This great administrative skill was best embodied in Yemane ‘The Secretary’. Born a farmer, Yemane originally owned only a small piece of land. His great administrative skills and wit allowed him to increase the yields of his farm manyfold, and he began to increase the yields of other farms in the local villages. Eventually, he would be noticed by Ayufar II during one of his yearly harvest processions, was recognized for this skill, and hired as the king’s personal secretary.

Yemane would be a crucial advisor to Ayufar II for most of his reign, being responsible for many administrative reforms in the kingdom. His most legendary feat was the mobilization of 10,000 men in a single month, although according to Yemane, it was no more than another task akin to organizing the harvest.

description.text:
1452年，暗影沼泽的巨魔打破了他们惯常的边境突袭，做出了自「弑影者」泽尼迪尔统治以来从未有过的举动——入侵阿米拉克之地。在「恐惧者」阿杜尔玛格崛起之后，一支巨魔大军入侵了舍洛克门吉，他们的目标是烧毁整个耶特河，洗劫海边的大城耶特梅兹拉。巨魔越过边境的消息传来时，只有9760名战士和108名魔法师及时集结。

在耶特河支流上的一个有城墙的木材小镇，舍洛克门吉的军队与阿杜玛格的部落发生了冲突。舍洛克门吉人在这里用长矛和盾牌坚守了14天，杀死了近2000名巨魔，最后城墙仍被攻破。此时，门吉人从桥上撤退，离开了小镇。这是一条假路，因为门吉人把巨魔困在镇子里，而他们的圈套很快被揭示。魔法师们一直在引导空气和天空本身，以产生强烈的光束，它可以让建筑物着火。浸泡在种子油中的锯屑燃起了熊熊大火，瞬间烧毁了涌入村庄的一半军队，包括阿杜尔玛格本人。那天，暗影巨魔害怕的不是他们的主人，而是舍洛克门吉人。
description.text_en:
In 1452 the trolls of Yezel Mora broke their usual border raids by doing something not seen since the rule of Zenidir the Shadowslayer - an invasion of Madriamilak. Following the rise of Adurmag the Dreadful, an army of trolls invaded Shelokmengi with the goal of burning the whole of the Yet river valley and sacking the great city of Yetmetsira by the ocean. When news of the host came, the Mezhi of Shelokmengi called to arms every able bodied man to defend the holy land, of which only 9,760 warriors and 108 magi gathered in time when news of the trolls crossing the border arrived.

At a small walled lumber town that bridged a tributary of the Yet did the army of Shelokmengi clash with Adurmag’s horde. Here with spear and shield the Shelokmengi held for 14 days, slaying nearmost 2,000 trolls until they finally breached the walls. At this point the Mengi withdrew over the bridge and out of the town. A feigned rout, as the Mengi held the trolls in the town whilst the deviousness of their trap was revealed. The magi had been channeling the very air and sky itself to create a beam of light so intense that it could catch buildings aflame. Sawdust soaked in seed oil caught alight in a great conflagration that instantly incinerated half the horde as it had clamored into the village, including Adurmag himself. That day, the Shadow Trolls feared not their masters, but the Shelokmengi.

description.text:
1438年，阿弗尔基三世死在埃尼克梅西基的门前，这对舍洛克门吉来说是一场灾难。他年轻的儿子被留在一个争吵不休的摄政议会手中，一心想把年轻的国王阿尤法里二世变成一个傀儡。

然而，当阿尤法二世到了统治的年龄，他并不是小国王们所期望的那样。他是当时最能干、最无情的管理者之一，他热衷于打击那些导致他父亲走向毁灭的人，包括摄政议会的前成员。他铲除了腐败的贵族，没收了那些敢于违抗他的人的土地，并把忠诚的人安排到他们的位置上。

在阿尤法38岁的时候，他已经完全摧毁了他王国中的任何内部抵抗。因此，他最终向埃尼克梅西基宣战，为他父亲的谋杀寻求报复，并追杀那些逃离他的复仇的贵族。他最终占领了他父亲在1474年被杀害的城市，完成了他的复仇。

多年以后，当被问及他对埃尼克梅西基「事件」的看法时，他打趣道：「埃尼克梅西基事件可能是一场灾难，但也是一种变相的祝福。」
description.text_en:
The death of Afwerki III at the gates of Enikmesiki in 1438 was a disaster for Shelokmengi. His young son was left in the hands of a squabbling regency council, bent on turning the young king Ayufar II into a puppet.

When Ayufar II came of age to rule, however, he was not what the lesser-kings expected him to be. One of the most capable and ruthless administrators of his day, he was keen to crack down on those that had led his father to ruin, including the former members of the regency council. He stamped out the corrupt nobles, confiscating the lands of those that dared defy him and placing loyalists into their positions.

By the time Ayufar reached the age of 38, he had completely destroyed any internal resistance in his kingdom. Thus he finally declared war on Enikmesiki, seeking revenge for his fathers murder and hunting those nobles who had fled his vengeance. He at last took the city where his father had been killed in 1474, his revenge complete.

Years later, when asked what his thoughts of the Enikmesiki "incident" was, he quipped, "Enikmesiki may have been a catastrophe, but it was also a blessing in disguise."

description.text: 每个耶特费雷王国都可能有一个丰收节，但舍洛克门吉有一个丰收游行。当收获季节开始时，舍洛克门吉的国王就会离开他的宫殿，在大队人马中走遍全国。这些游行起到了移动丰收节的作用，大量的食物被免费赠送。舍洛克门吉的丰收游行非常普遍，因为舍洛克门吉的国王想在他们的对手面前炫耀他们的财富。这些丰收游行展示了舍洛克门吉的所有财富，以及其统治的好处。最重要的是，它使下层民众对舍洛克门吉国王感到高兴和忠诚。
description.text_en: Every Yeteferen kingdom may have a harvest festival, but Shelokmengi has a harvest procession. When the harvest season begins, the king of Shelokmengi leaves his palace and travels the land in a great procession. These processions acted as moving harvest festivals, with massive amounts of food given away for free. It was very common for the harvest processions of Shelokmengi to move into other kingdoms, as the kings of Shelokmengi sought to flaunt their wealth in the face of their rivals. These harvest processions showed all the richness of Shelokmengi, and the benefits of its rule. Most importantly, it made the lower classes happy and loyal to the kings of Shelokmengi.

description.text: 阿尤法二世的继任者将继续他的中央集权和安抚王国和小国王的工作。到16世纪末，舍洛克门吉的小国王们已经被削弱到仅仅作为世袭行政长官的地步，王国中几乎所有的实权都掌握在国王和他在贝尔凡大宫殿中的亲密顾问圈手中。
description.text_en: The successors of Ayufar II would continue his work of centralizing and pacifying the realm and the lesser-kings. By the late 16th century, the lesser-kings of Shelokmengi had been weakened to the point where they merely served as hereditary administrators, with almost all real power in the kingdom resting in the hands of the king and his close circle of advisors in the great palace in Berfan.

description.text: 「弑影者」泽尼迪尔的遗产是伟大的。在泽尼迪尔统治的500多年里，耶特费雷语在阿米拉克之地传播开来，并最终演变成了现代的门吉语。泽尼迪尔在位期间，指挥建造了一百多座城市和定居点，他的行动旨在振兴后来成为阿米拉克之地的游牧部落。泽尼迪尔帮助成千上万的人过上了更好、更文明的生活，他还帮助编纂了这片土地上的法律，为这个饱受暗影沼泽黑暗势力蹂躏的王国带来了和平。随着梅拉克门吉的重生，我们将像他们一样，努力改善阿米拉克所有臣民的生活。
description.text_en: The Legacy of Zenidir the Shadowslayer is a great one. Over the course of over 500 years, Zenidir’s rule saw the spread of the Yeteferen language across Madriamilak, which eventually evolved into the modern Mengi language. Their actions sought to uplift the nomadic tribes of what would become Madriamilak, directing the construction of over a hundred cities and settlements over his reign. Uplifting thousands to a better, more civilized life, Zenidir helped codify the laws of the land and bring peace to a realm savaged by the dark forces of Yezel Mora. With Melakmengi reborn, we will do the same as they did, and seek to better the lives of all of Amilak’s subjects.

description.text: 魔法使用者的重要性不容低估。门吉人自己的魔法主要分为两个权威区域：塔尼克韦亚和塞马耶巴卡。与风、天空和水有关的力量由塞马耶巴卡，即云雾法师和大雨祭司掌管。在现代的梅拉克门吉，他们的影响力相当大，因为他们是灌溉庄稼和保持土地清洁的仪式和礼仪的主要传递者。塞马耶巴卡协会是最近成立的一个由高级塞马耶巴卡组成的集会，与国家紧密合作，通过该协会，梅拉克门吉的各种魔法神职人员可以更有效地为国家利益服务。
description.text_en: The importance of magic users cannot be understated. Magic among the Mengi themselves is primarily divided into two districts of authority, the Tanikweya and the Semayebaka. The forces associated with the wind, skies, and waters are entrusted to the Semayebaka, the Cloud-mages and Rain-priests. In modern Melakmengi, they are quite influential as they are the primary deliverers of rites, and rituals that see crops irrigated and the land kept clean. Through the institution of the Semayebaka Society, a recently-founded conclave of high ranking Semayebaka that works closely with the state, the various magical clergy of Melakmengi can be directed to serve the interests of the state more effectively.

description.text:
数千年来，我们一直与伊利拉克的军队进行着无休止的战争。他们时不时地从暗影沼泽出发，使我们的土地荒芜。他们魔鬼般的特征、无与伦比的体格、惊人的再生能力和严酷的栖息地使巨魔成为我们无法战胜的敌人。随着时间的推移，我们开发出了消灭巨魔的技术，但仍处于根本性的劣势。只要有一个巨魔还在，阿米拉克之地就不安全。

然而在16世纪，大炮出现在了我们的港口，它是由罗祆和坎诺商人带来的。我们欣然接受了这种武器，并将其变成了我们自己的武器，生产出了我们自己的变体和设计，其中许多在对付暗影沼泽的巨魔时派上了用场。火炮最终让我们在与憎恨的敌人作战时占据了优势，因此它在门吉的战术和战略中始终占据着核心地位。
description.text_en:
For thousands of years we have fought an unending war against the armies of Yrilak. Periodically they march out from the Yezel Mora and desolate our lands. Their devilish features, unmatched stature, incredible regeneration abilities and harsh homeland make the trolls an undefeatable enemy. With time we developed techniques to destroy the troll, yet we were still left at a fundamental disadvantage. For as long as a single troll still stands, Madriamilak is not safe.

However in the 16th century, the cannon appeared in our ports, brought in by Raheni and Cannorian merchants. We readily adopted the weaponry and made it our own, producing our own variants and designs, many of which found use against the trolls of the Yezel Mora. Artillery finally gave us the advantage against our hated enemies, and as such it will always carry a central role in Mengi tactics and strategy.

name.text_en: An End To The Trollish Menace

description.text:
「今天早上，阿米拉克从天上给我送来了一个预兆：五群鸟儿——山雀、崖隼、金雕、河鸫和奥费希伯鹤。它们不约而同地飞过天空，直到落在一棵枯树上，其他的鸟儿——北方的大草原燕子、达金什的库阿蓝鸟和更远的地方的数百只鸟儿都栖息在树枝下。所有的鸟儿都向最后到达的大鹰鞠躬致敬，这只大鹰长着纯白色的翅膀，坐在最高的栖木上。信息明确，阿米拉克已经开始了祂统一诸神族的战争，我们必须在这个世界上也这样做。」

——大祭司耶内托蒂，1737年，《团结宣言》
description.text_en:
"Amilak has sent a portent to me this morn from the heavens, of a flock of five birds - the Hill Sparrow, the Cliff Falcon, the Golden Eagle, the River Thrush, and the Ofehibi Crane. Each in unison flew across the sky until they landed upon a dead tree, where other birds - the Savannah Swallow of the northern lands, the Blue Coua of the Dakinshi and a hundred more of lands further beyond who perched upon the lower branches. All bowed in reverence to the great eagle that arrived last, a great beast who sat upon the highest perch with pure white wings. The message was clear. Amilak had begun his war to unite the God-Kin, and we must do the same upon this world."

- High Priest Yenetoti, 1737, Declaration of Unity

description.text: 祈雨修会是塞马耶巴卡协会的一个会社和部门，肩负着召唤降雨和缓和危险风暴的神圣职责。当地的领主和土地所有者与祈雨修会的代表密切合作，确保农田定期降雨，并提前几个月制定降雨时间表。在一些地区，由于阿米拉克之地的和平与统一，教育系统得以更广泛地使用，从而产生了大量的降雨祭司，因此这一工作得到了进一步简化。其必然结果是农作物产量越来越高，即使是最贫穷的门吉人也能通过国家采购的稳定粮食补贴定期获得食物。
description.text_en: The Order of Rains is a conclave and section of the Semayebaka Society that is invested with the holy duties of summoning rain and moderating dangerous storms. Local Mezhi and freeholders work closely with representatives from the Order to ensure farm fields regularly receive rain, with timetables scheduled months in advance. In some regions this is further streamlined as peace and unity over Madriamilak allows wider access to an education system that produces masses of rain priests. The inevitable result is increasingly large crop yields, allowing even the poorest Mengi to be fed regularly by a steady subsidy of grain procured by the state.

description.text:
第一梅拉克门吉帝国是一个绝对君主制国家，万王之王泽尼迪尔·赞提里扎尔拥有绝对的权威。但在实践中，它却像一个邦联一样进行管理，帝国的10个地区都设有总督，他们像国王一样代替泽尼迪尔进行统治。后来的门吉历史学家和政治家批评这种统治方式非常不稳定，只有龙的意志力才能将其维系在一起。

当第二梅拉克门吉帝国成立时，其统治者选择不效仿泽尼迪尔的统治方式，而是邀请来自罗祆和烟州的学者和管理者，寻求建立一个高效的官僚政府和中央集权的帝国。凭借这支新的管理者军队，万王之王逐步摧毁并最终摧毁了顽固不化的封建权力结构，在这个时代，小领主们变得越来越无足轻重。
description.text_en:
The first Melakmengi Empire was an absolute monarchy, the Mezhi`Mezhi Zenidir Zentirizar wielding absolute authority. Yet in practice it governed like a confederation, governors being assigned to the 10 regions of the empire, who ruled like kings in Zenidir’s stead. Later Mengi historians and statesmen came to criticize this style of rule as uniquely unstable, only held together by the force of will of a dragon.

When the second Melakmengi Empire formed, its rulers chose to not emulate Zenidir’s style of rule, and instead invited scholars and administrators from Rahen and Yanshen, seeking to build an efficient bureaucratic government and a centralized empire. With this new army of administrators, successive Mezhi`Mezhi chipped away at and ultimately destroyed the feudal power structures that stubbornly refused to die, in an era that made the lesser-lords increasingly irrelevant.

name.text_en: A New Administration For A New Empire

description.text:
千百年来，外国商人来到阿米拉克之地，带来了新思想和财富。然而，这些外国人的势力和影响力却在海岸线上不断增长，这种寄生关系最终在15世纪摧毁了沿海的奥费希伯王国。16和17世纪，坎诺商人开始出现在东部沿海地区，他们带来了新技术，但也带来了有悖于阿米拉克真理的颠覆性思想。

第二梅拉克门吉帝国采取了与之前的王国截然不同的做法。1758年，万王之王下令在达克门德和耶特梅斯拉建立所谓的「纳吉德垄断」，这是一种垄断和自由贸易区制度，外国人可以进入这些地区经商，但不得深入阿米拉克之地，必要时可以使用武力。国内的商人公司需要获得国家颁发的许可证才能与外国商人进行贸易，国家从利润中抽取一定的比例。
description.text_en:
For millennia foreign merchants have come to Madriamilak, bringing with them new ideas and wealth. However, these foreigners grew in power and influence along the coastline, a parasitic relationship that eventually destroyed the coastal Ofehibi kingdoms in the 15th century. In the 16th and 17th centuries, Cannorian traders started to appear along the eastern coast, bringing new technologies, but also destabilizing ideas that went against Amilak’s truth.

The 2nd Melakmengi Empire took a very different approach to the kingdoms that preceded it. In 1758, the Mezhi’Mezhi decreed the creation of what became known as "The Nagide Monopoly", a system of monopolies and free trade zones in Dakmender and Yetmesira into which foreigners could enter to do business, while being prohibited from venturing deeper into Madriamilak, by force if necessary. Domestic merchant companies needed a license from the state to trade with foreign merchants, with the state taking a comfortable percentage of the profits.

player_overview.avoid_if: 只想纯征服，或不愿处理阶层关系、农业投资和改革前置。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 前期投资谷物与阶层关系，中期用天气和粮仓支持战争，后期收回贵族军权并准备地区统一。
player_overview.overview: 舍洛克门吉从贵族摄政下的肥沃谷地起步，年轻的阿尤法二世将依靠雨祭司、学者与外来专家削弱贵族权力。你把农田、谷物神庙、天气行动和粮仓改革连接起来，以稳定收成供养更大军队，最终争取统一门吉。它并非纯粹温和的农业童话：奴隶参与收割，哈里玛利既可能被驱逐，也可以成为合作商人。
player_overview.recommended_for: 喜欢农业经营、天气魔法、阶层政治和中等长度人物故事的玩家。
signature_features: 天空领域的晴日与洪水行动服务农业和防御。
粮仓改革把生产建设转化为征兵、陆军规模与补给能力。
年轻国王通过祭司与行政改革改变贵族主导的权力结构。
player_overview.tagline: 让祭司安排晴雨，让粮仓供养军队，把贵族谷地改造成行政王国。

phase_scores.phase: 哈里玛利宽容商贸路线

positive_indicators: 修建港口、神庙和粮食设施
可选接纳哈里玛利并发展贸易
values.rationale: 农业设施、改善劳动条件、河流航运与跨地区招贤支持公共利益；但粮食生产原文明确有奴隶收割，哈里玛利低容忍分支还要求驱逐修正、移除少数群体和文化改造。高容忍分支增加少数群体并支持商贸，是实际缓和而非自动全面平等。战争、君主集权、普通税收、地区统一本身不扣分；少数群体移除不扩写为已证实屠杀。阶段分对应可选待遇路线，均保留奴隶劳动背景。
red_flags: 收割叙事明确使用奴隶劳动
低容忍任务分支要求驱逐并移除哈里玛利少数群体
